The current Search page source no longer contains the old 'not fully specified' qualifier, and the separate FHIR-43208 date-search example cleanup already landed on the combined branch without conflicting with this wording.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. An empty audit commit was published because source/search.html already states that matches against dates are based on intervals determined by precision.
